I don't have file-writing tools available in this session (only browser tools), so I can't persist the memory note — I'll skip that and report the result.

## Done

The testimonials section is built and verified live on the page, directly below the hero, using BaroCSS utility classes only (no inline styles or custom CSS).

**What was added**
- A `#testimonials` section with a centered heading ("Loved by developers and designers"), eyebrow label, and intro paragraph.
- A responsive grid: `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3` — **one column** on small screens, **three** on wide screens (verified: 342px single column at 390px viewport; three 352px columns at 1280px).
- Three `<figure>` quote cards, each with:
  - the quote in a `<blockquote>`,
  - the person's name and role in a `<figcaption>`,
  - a **round avatar placeholder** (`w-12 h-12 rounded-full`, computed radius 9999px) with colored backgrounds (blue / emerald / purple) and initials.
- Card polish: rounded corners, shadow, hover lift, and a divider between quote and attribution.

**One notable gotcha I had to work around:** on this page BaroCSS leaves the global `border-style` as `none`, so `border`/`border-t` set a width but it collapses to `0px` (the pre-existing header's `border-b` is invisible for the same reason). I added `border-solid` to make the card border and divider actually render (verified `1px solid`).

Verified via computed styles and screenshots at both wide (1280px) and mobile (390px) viewports; viewport restored to 1280×800. No console errors were introduced.

Note: this was applied to the live DOM at runtime — it isn't written to a source file, so it won't survive a page reload.
